title: Agents & Conversation — Where It Stands
thesis: A deliberate inversion of LangChain and AutoGen: a governed, declarative substrate where an LLM only proposes and can never act. It is strongest exactly where the peers are weakest — safety, governance, determinism — and deliberately absent exactly where they lead: LLM-driven tool selection, autonomous planning, live multi-agent chat, and RAG.

lanes.note: stzAgentWorkbench rehearses into a virtual-filesystem twin; a separate committing actor executes the plan under three gates; the disk provably does not move
Five statically-proven invariants feed the one CI gate; no-llm-effectful enforced at two doors (graph construction and engine registration)
An agent is a closed, versioned .pia file judged at LOAD by a sequence of courts; a defect is a refusal, one per gate (14 refusal codes)
agentloop.zig: Zig owns time, Ring runs Cycle(), no callback into the Ring VM; determinism proven as a test; 15 Zig unit tests
llm_actor proposes via stzLLMFunction + stzOutputSchema, compiled to GBNF so invalid tokens are unemittable; a proposal is a candidate, never an effect
stzConversation: goal-driven loop in a stzKnowledgeGraph, questions born from gaps, governed Admit, persists as .zcnv; no intent classification
stzAgentMemory over stzKnowledgeGraph: Learn/Recall/Forget/Prove over triples, persistable; no buffer/summary/vector memory variety
stzLLMFunction: typed returns, call budget, retries, goldens, template prompt, real GGUF backend; no chain/pipeline ecosystem or prompt registry
stzAgentGraph composes roles and edges and proves soundness; no runtime multi-agent conversation orchestrator, native roster one-fifth wired
A skill's ring:<Function> clause binds a Ring function under an execution posture; no LLM-driven tool selection -- a deliberate refusal
Deterministic perceive->decide->act to a fixpoint (stzPIAgent.Pursue, RunToQuiet); no LLM-driven planning, the planner agent reserved
Not wired into the agent tier; stzSemanticIndex lives on the Neural tier and is not connected to agent proposal or memory

standouts: a provable governance graph (five static invariants)
agents as .pia files judged at load
a Zig-owned tick loop with no callback into Ring
